items.title: HPE修補ArubaOS-CX網路作業系統34個資安漏洞，包含可導致遠端程式碼執行的重大漏洞
items.summary: HPE於9月2日發布資安公告，修補ArubaOS-CX網路作業系統（AOS-CX）34個漏洞。

items.title: 微軟破記錄修補近1,000個自家產品漏洞
items.summary: 9月9日微軟發布本月例行更新（Patch Tuesday），其中最受到關注的部分，就是這次修補的漏洞數量，他們一共修補974個該公司登記CVE編號的漏洞，相較於上個月421個多出一倍。若再加上25個第三方元件的資安弱點，漏洞總數將達到999個。

items.title: Google推出Chrome 153，修補230個漏洞，其中包含V8零時差漏洞
items.summary: 9月8日Google發布Chrome 153大改版，此為該公司規畫以兩週為改版週期的第一個版本，這次該公司總共修補230個漏洞，其中有5個為重大等級、41個高風險等級、133個中度風險等級，以及51個低風險等級。值得留意的是，其中一個漏洞CVE-2026-87491已遭到利用。

items.title: 原估需數年，Claude多代理系統11天完成費馬最後定理形式化證明
items.summary: Anthropic公布費馬最後定理形式化（Formalizing）成果，以Claude Code為基礎的多代理系統花11天，第一次完成可由Lean證明助理從頭到尾檢查的形式化證明。整項工程產生約1,300萬行Lean程式碼，完成30,300項定理證明，最終證明使用29,500項。

items.title: 微軟提高Exchange Online版本門檻，Exchange 2016、2019寄信恐受限
items.summary: 微軟宣布從今年9月第二週起，提高Exchange Server 2016與2019連接Exchange Online時必須符合的最低版本要求。企業若仍使用過舊版本，並透過OnPremises類型的輸入連接器將郵件送往Exchange Online，相關郵件可能先被限制傳送速率，之後進一步遭到封鎖。

items.title: 美加法院案件管理平臺資料外洩，敏感個資與機密資料恐受影響
items.summary: 資訊與專業服務業者Thomson Reuters旗下法院案件管理平臺C-Track發生資料外洩，有第三方未經授權取得部分法院檔案。遭取得的資料可能包含姓名、社會安全碼、駕照號碼、出生日期、醫療及健康保險資訊，部分法院的機密資料、經遮蔽或封存的資訊也可能受到影響。

items.title: fix(cli): reject blank node numeric options before RPC (#137311)
items.summary: fix(cli): reject blank node numeric options before RPC (#137311) Treat only undefined and null as omitted optional node numbers. Let explicit empty and whitespace input reach the existing strict numeric validators before node lookup and Gateway requests. Preserve the contributor repair and add null/undefined and whitespace controls. Real built CLI proof verifies the original failure, local rejection after repair, unchanged legal and omitted values, and no state or device effects in the isolated fixture. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(agents): retry silent malformed tool rejections (#142176)
items.summary: fix(agents): retry silent malformed tool rejections (#142176) ## What Problem This Solves A provider can consume output tokens before rejecting a malformed tool call. When that rejection leaves no visible answer or executable action, positive token usage prevented OpenClaw's existing silent-error retry. The user received a failed turn after one request even when a second attempt could succeed. ## Why This Change Was Made Let the existing retry owner recognize the stable malformed-tool error code and five exact transport-owned rejection messages after its visibility, terminal-state and replay-safety checks. Message matching preserves case, whitespace and punctuation exactly. Parsing stays strict, and the existing budget remains three retries after the initial request. ## User Impact Transient malformed tool output can recover through the same model or the existing configured fallback. Visible output, admitted actions, possible effects, active work, approvals and terminal failures retain their retry vetoes. A valid tool call from a later attempt still follows normal policy. Fixes #135111. ## Evidence - Real isolated built Gateway through public `chat.send`, `agent.wait` and `chat.history`, with local Messages/Responses streams and counted tool actions. - Main: one failed request and zero rejected-call executions. Candidate: recovery in two requests; a later valid tool executes once across three requests; repeated rejection stops at four requests; configured fallback succeeds on request five. - Independent public scenarios cover same-session replay, visibility, accepted work, real background activity, pending approval and owner cancellation, refusal, timeout, abort, authentication/context errors, and unrelated Responses errors. Additional real channel delivery and an potentially mutating action that made no domain change preserve the retry fence. - 316 focused tests pass, including the exact-match regressions, retry/fallback owner, asynchronous settlement and permanent WebSocket-close producer. Formatting, lint, size/assertion guards and the native commit hook pass. Native early asynchronous provider eligibility and typed terminal-code precedence are covered at their unchanged component boundaries. The local provider fixtures do not claim an official-provider live result. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
